title: Role matrix editor, TUI half: edit, add, remove and move rows from the matrix pane
lead: The Roadmap's role matrix pane (`m`) gets five edit keys: change a row, add a row, remove a row, move a row, and edit a rule's text. Each edit asks for its fields one at a time, shows the exact `slicer relay-roles ...` command with `[y/N] (Enter is No)`, runs it on `y`, and shows the reloaded matrix. It uses the `matrix.edit` method of the wire half and changes nothing in the daemon.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Second half of S173 (owner, 2026-10-31: split S173 into a wire half and a TUI half; agent, vendor and model are free text, with a warning when ork has no adapter for the agent). Depends on `matrix-editor-wire` (S173 after the split): `matrix.edit` with `preview`, its `command` and `warning`, and the `vendor`, `model`, `reasoning` and `note` fields on `roles.matrix` rows. Do not start before that slice has landed.

Owner decisions of 2026-10-29 (S173 note) still hold: TUI only, the five verbs `add`, `set`, `remove`, `move`, `rule-edit`, and edits left uncommitted. The matrix is slicer's; ork shows the command it will run and slicer's own refusals verbatim (`docs/boundaries.md:14`, `lineup.source`).

State of the code at HEAD (2026-10-31): the matrix pane is read-only and has no row cursor. `j`/`k` and `pgup`/`pgdown` scroll it (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:87-100`, routed at `internal/tui/model.go:697-698`), and `docs/dashboard.md:1527-1529` says no other key acts in it. The pane draws a `## ork` section with one line per row, then slicer's text (`matrixLines`, `roadmap.go:153-185`); the result it holds is `itemPane.matrix` (`roadmap.go:20-27`). `n` (new slice) and `N` (note) are refused while the pane is open (`internal/tui/compose.go:47-48`), so those letters are free there. The status area already draws one-off prompts (`internal/tui/view.go:129-157`, the note and new-slice forms) over `textField` (`internal/tui/field.go`). A `Live` test double is extended through an optional interface, as `itemFiler` and `itemNoter` are (`compose.go:163-167`), so `Live` and its fakes stay as they are.

Design (*proposed*; the choices that are the owner's are listed in the manifest):
- Keys while the pane is open and its matrix has loaded: `e` edit a row, `n` add a row, `d` remove a row, `m` move a row, `r` edit a rule's text (the defaults named in the S173 spec). `esc` cancels an edit in progress, then closes the pane as today.
- One prompt at a time, two status lines: `Edit r5 (2/6)  Model, now: opus` over the input. `enter` keeps the value typed (empty means unchanged) and goes to the next field; `shift+tab` goes back; `esc` cancels; paste never submits (`textField`). The first prompt of `e`, `d` and `m` is the row id, checked against the loaded rows before any call ("no row r99"); `r` asks for a rule id from the loaded rules. `e` then asks agent, vendor, model, reasoning and note; `n` asks the role (required), then the same five; `m` asks for the row to place it before (empty means last); `r` asks for the new text (prefilled with the rule's current text). Clearing a field is left to `slicer relay-roles set` (empty means unchanged here).
- After the last field the TUI calls `matrix.edit` with `preview: true`, then shows `Run: <command>` (the daemon's `command`), the `warning` if any in the warning colour (agent with no adapter: "a plan skips this row"), and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`. `y` calls `matrix.edit` again without `preview` and reloads `roles.matrix`; `n`, `enter` and `esc` make no run call. Slicer's refusal (code and message) is shown verbatim in the status and keeps the prompt open for a change.
- The change stays uncommitted in the project (owner, 2026-10-29); the status says so after success: `Edited r5 (uncommitted)`.

Class: N (the TUI package, goldens and docs only; no engine, daemon or cmd path is listed, which is what the wave check reads). It uses the wire half's params and result types from the daemon package. UI slice: yes.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
`internal/tui/matrix_edit_test.go`, with a fake (`matrixEditLive`) like `matrixLive` in `matrix_test.go:20-40` that also implements `MatrixEdit` and records every call. The form is the owner's of 2026-11-11: typed-id lines, `tab`/`shift+tab` between lines, `enter` on the last line or `ctrl+s` sends.
- `TestMatrixEditKeysOpenOnlyOnALoadedMatrix`: with the pane open and its matrix loaded, `e`, `n`, `d`, `m` and `r` each open a form (and the first `esc` cancels it, the second closes the pane); with the reply still pending, with a failed read, with no daemon, or with a `Live` that lacks `matrixEditor`, they do nothing and the status says why (`Matrix not loaded; editing unavailable`, `No daemon connection; action unavailable`, `Matrix editing unavailable`). Outside the matrix pane the letters keep their meanings (`n` new slice, `N` note).
- `TestMatrixEditAsksFieldsOneLineEachAndSendsOnlyFilledOnes`: `e`, row `r5` (pasted, which never sends), the current values show dim, `enter` moves on, model `opus`: exactly one preview call with `Op: "set"`, `ID: "r5"`, `Fields: {"model": "opus"}`, `Preview: true`, made in the command. A second run types an agent too, goes back with `shift+tab` and sends from `enter` on the last line.
- `TestMatrixEditEnterSendsOnlyFromTheLastLine`, `TestMatrixEditNeedsAFieldToChange`, `TestMatrixEditRemoveSendsTheRow`, `TestMatrixEditStatusAfterEachOp`, `TestMatrixEditTypesPlusAndMinus`, `TestMatrixEditCtrlCQuits`, `TestMatrixEditEndsWhenTheProjectChanges`, `TestDaemonMatrixEditAsksTheDaemon`.
- `TestMatrixEditRowMustExist`: row `r99` shows `no row r99` and makes no call; the cursor returns to the id line; `d` and `m` check the id and the row to go before; an empty id says `Row id must not be empty`.
- `TestMatrixEditAddNeedsARole`: `n` with an empty role shows `Role must not be empty`; with `reviewer` and `Codex` the preview has `Op: "add"`, `Fields: {"role": "reviewer", "agent": "Codex"}`.
- `TestMatrixEditMoveSendsBeforeOrLast`: `m`, `r5`, `r2` sends `Before: "r2"`; an empty line sends `Last: true`.
- `TestMatrixEditRuleSendsTheText`: `r`, `u99` is refused (`no rule u99`); `u3` fills the text line with the rule's text on `tab`; editing it sends `Op: "rule-edit"`, `ID: "u3"`, the new `Text`; an empty text is refused.
- `TestMatrixEditConfirmShowsTheExactCommandAndNeverRunsOnNoOrEnter`: after the form is sent the view shows `Run: ` and the daemon's `command` text and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`; `n`, `enter` and `esc` leave the fake with the preview call only.
- `TestMatrixEditYRunsOnceAndReloadsTheMatrix`: `y` makes one run call (`Preview` false) with the previewed params, then one `RolesMatrix` read, the pane shows the new matrix at the same scroll offset, and the status reads `Edited r5 (uncommitted)`; the keys stay refused while the reload is out.
- `TestMatrixEditWarnsOnARowOrkCannotRun`: a preview reply with `Warning` shows it in the warning colour (bold in mono) between the command and the question; the edit can still be confirmed.
- `TestMatrixEditShowsSlicersRefusalVerbatim`: a run error with code `unknown_role_row` and its message shows both in the status and keeps the form; no reload happens; a refused preview shows too.
- `TestMatrixEditIgnoresAStaleReply`: a reply for an earlier request id (the editor was cancelled, or a later editor waits for its own preview) changes nothing; while a call is out only `esc` acts.
- `TestMatrixEditHintLine`: at 100 columns the hint line offers `e/n/d/m/r edit` beside the page and line fields; at 80x24 it drops, with `esc close`, `q quit` and `? help` kept; the form and the help have their own lines.
- `TestMatrixEditorGoldens`: the form (row id, then the model line) and the confirm with a warning, at 80x24 and 100x30, colour and mono (`checkGolden`), written to `testdata/golden/matrix-edit-*.txt` and `matrix-edit-confirm-*.txt`.
- Existing tests: `TestMatrixPaneScrollsLikeTheItemPane`, `TestMatrixKeyIsOfferedOnlyOnTheRoadmap`, `TestMatrixPaneGolden` keep passing unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first; see each fail for the stated reason.

1. `matrix_edit.go`: `type matrixEditor interface { MatrixEdit(context.Context, daemon.MatrixEditParams) (*daemon.MatrixEditResult, error) }` and `var _ matrixEditor = (*Daemon)(nil)`; the state (op, ordered prompts with labels and current values from the loaded rows, typed values, step, request id, previewed params, command, warning); the key handler; the commands that call preview and run in `tea.Cmd`s, never in `Update`.
2. Prompts: build the field list per op as described in Why. Show the current value from the row (`Vendor`, `Model`, `Reasoning`, `Note` from the wire half) as dim text after the label. Validate the row id and rule id against the loaded `Rows` and `Rules` before any call.
3. Routing: the editor takes every key while open (before the pane keys), including `ctrl+c` quit as `composeKey` does. Opening is refused with the statuses in the tests. While a preview or run is pending, only `esc` acts, and its reply is ignored by request id.
4. Drawing: status area only, two lines for a prompt, three or four for the confirm (command, warning, question), clipped to the pane width; no new pane layout. Check 80x24 and 100x30.
5. Reload: after a successful run, re-issue the `roles.matrix` read the way `openMatrix` does and replace the pane's matrix; keep `offset`.
6. Hint line and `?` help as in Files; mark the keys *proposed* in the docs until the owner confirms them.
7. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md` describes the five keys, the one-field-at-a-time prompts, the confirm prompt, the warning, and that the change is left uncommitted.
8. `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the new goldens; no existing golden may change except the hint-line ones, if any.
9. `CHANGELOG.md`: one entry under `## Unreleased`, added last.
10. Do not touch `internal/daemon`, `internal/slicercli`, `internal/cli`, or the read-only rendering of the matrix. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): How does the full form work now that the owner picked "form" (decision 271, `ui.matrix-editor-interaction`)? -> form as typed-id lines: the form shows the row id (or rule id) first, then agent, vendor, model, reasoning and note (role first for `n`), one line each, with the current value dim beside each. `tab` and `shift+tab` move between lines, `enter` on the last line (or `ctrl+s`) calls `matrix.edit` with `preview: true`, and the confirm line is `Run: <command>`, the warning, then `[y/N] (Enter is No)`. Keys `e n d m r` stay. Fields are checked against the loaded rows before any call. [ui.matrix-editor-form-layout].

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (must print nothing)
- `slicer check`
- `adj lint`
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 100x30 and 80x24, in a scratch project (`slicer init`, `slicer relay-roles init`, registered with `ork projects add`), open the matrix with `m`, change a model with `e`, confirm that the command shown is the one that ran (`slicer relay-roles show`), that `n` and Enter cancel, and that an unknown agent shows the warning. Do not edit the real project's matrix for this check.
